t: Running, Walking, and Cycling Pace Calculator | Darbi
Enter distance, time, weight, and elevation to instantly get your pace, speed, estimated calories, and clear splits for every kilometer, with no account or data sent to any server.
Calculate your workout pace and splits instantly

Quick answer: enter your workout numbers here and in a second you'll get pace per kilometer, average speed, estimated calories, and splits you can read while resting. The idea is simple: Darbi uses what you enter manually for distance, time, weight, and elevation, then turns it into clear numbers to help you compare sessions and plan your next one without complexity. No account, no subscription, no data sent anywhere, and everything stays on this page while you use it. If you're cycling you'll get longer splits, and if you're walking or running you'll get accurate pace per kilometer. Start by adjusting the numbers already there, then press Calculate results.
Results are ready as soon as you enter the numbers.
These are calculated estimates based on your manual input and are not sent anywhere.
Do I need an account or email?
No. Open the page and enter your numbers directly, with no signup, email, or subscription.
Is my data saved after I close the page?
No. Calculations happen in the browser only while the page is open, and the page writes no information to device storage or to a server.
Once the page is open, it makes no network requests, so the calculator stays usable in the open page even if the connection drops.
The calculator uses activity type, your weight, and workout duration, with a small adjustment for elevation gain; the result is an estimate, not a lab measurement.
Can I use it for cycling?
Yes. Choose cycling, and the default split becomes five kilometers, which you can change manually.
Enter a distance greater than zero to see results.
